text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Bubble Gum Fellow's 
long-awaited debut race had finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Man, so glad Bubble-chan's debut race was 
in Tokyo. Made cheering for her a total 
breeze!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...She seemed in good shape yesterday 
too. I'm sure she'll put on a great run."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Shall we watch closely, then? Our 
'vanguard captain's' maiden battle—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
My condition is in top shape. My head is 
clear, and I'm feeling great.
choice_data_list:
You don't even seem nervous. Impressive as 
always.

You don't even seem nervous. Impressive as 
always, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even before entering Tracen Academy, I 
competed in plenty of club races, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe there's some sort of... getting 
used to it, in that sense. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Today is my very first real race in the 
Twinkle Series. I've got to get totally 
fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, I'm all fired up for the 
final prep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Bubble Gum Fellow's eyes, a fighting 
spirit burned even stronger than before. 
To me, it felt remarkably reassuring.
choice_data_list:
First, let's go have fun in your debut 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She aims high, but today's debut is a 
once-in-a-lifetime moment. First, I want 
her to just enjoy it...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you too, Trainer! I'm gonna 
make this the best debut race ever.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: âI'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We bump fists, and I send her off with 
strong encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sounds and passion from that time have 
once again breathed life into our dreams—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like one of those so-called "Four 
Heavenly Kings" is making her debut today. 
Wonder how good she is.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"She's quite the elite, right? I can't 
help but get my hopes up a bit."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then... Let's put it to the test—
